claims.text: git ls-tree --name-only <tree-ish> <path>/ lists the names of the entries directly inside that directory at the given revision, one per line, without recursing.
Layers split code by kind of work and modules by bounded context; a module keeps its own share of each layer, and how many projects it fills is a separate choice.

Each module can pick the inside design its subdomain needs: the supporting product list gets something simple, the core ordering keeps a domain model; forcing one template on every module adds empty projects where there are no rules.
At stage-3 Catalog's public types are exactly CatalogModule, CatalogProduct and ICatalog; ModuleBoundaryTests fails if the exported set differs.
Keeping every controller in the host and starting each module below HTTP is this repository's choice; a module could also hold its own controllers.
